# secureaccess_network_object (Data Source)

This data source reads the Network Object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_network_object" "example" {
  id = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the Network Object.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the Network Object.
- `type` (String) Type of the Network Object.
- `value` (String) Address of the Network Object.
